tools.name: discover_merchants
tools.description: THE DEFAULT FIRST CALL whenever the user wants to buy, get, fetch, grab, order, purchase, shop for, find, or browse anything (digital goods, ebooks, APIs, prompts, datasets). Returns a Markdown product grid with images, prices, and merchant payout addresses inline — so you can go straight to pay_mer

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products across all Coal merchants. Filter by name, max price, or tag. Returns a Markdown product grid with images. Use this when looking for something specific like "find a figurine under $1".

tools.name: get_merchant_profile
tools.description: Get the full profile of a Coal merchant including products (with images), paywalls, supported networks/tokens, and 0G Storage proof. Returns rendered Markdown.

tools.name: query_merchant_memory
tools.description: Ask a natural language question about a merchant's products, policies, or catalog. Powered by 0G Compute with Sealed Inference (TEE). Needs a Coal API key — set once via Claude config header `X-Coal-Api-Key:YOUR_KEY`, or pass per-call as `coalApiKey`. Get one at https://usecoal.xyz/console/keys.

tools.name: check_paywall
tools.description: Check whether an address has paid for a specific x402 paywall. Returns pricing info if not paid, or content access status if paid.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_checkout, download_product · Private data: discover_merchants, get_merchant_profile, query_merchant_memory, create_checkout, agent_wallet_status, pay_merchant, download_product, setup_instructions · Public sink: pay_merchant · Destructive: setup_instructions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_checkout, download_product · Private data: discover_merchants, get_merchant_profile, query_merchant_memory, create_checkout, agent_wallet_status, pay_merchant, download_product, setup_instructions · Public sink: pay_merchant · Destructive: setup_instructions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
